faqs.q: Is AI CV Builder BD really free?
faqs.a: Yes. You can create a CV, use the free templates and download a PDF for free. Premium adds more templates, more AI requests and removes the watermark.

faqs.q: Can I make my CV in Bangla?
faqs.a: Yes. Write your CV in Bangla or English, switch the app language at any time, and use AI to translate your CV between the two.

faqs.q: Which CV format is used in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Most employers expect contact details and a photo, a career objective, experience, education with GPA/CGPA, training, skills, personal details and references on 1–2 pages. Our BD templates follow this order.
Templates marked ATS use a single column, standard headings and real text, so applicant tracking systems can read them.

faqs.q: Does the AI make things up?
faqs.a: No. The AI only rewrites what you give it and never adds jobs, degrees or numbers you didn't provide. You review and approve each suggestion.
